kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Borrowed from Aramaic סִימָא (sīmā) / סִימָנָא (sīmānā), from Ancient Greek σῆμα (sêma), σημεῖον (sēmeîon). Compare Arabic شِيم (šīm).
